name: EPCG/CEDIS/CGES Consolidated Data Center at Zeljezara Niksic
notes: Strategic cooperation announced to establish a Consolidated Data Center in the Zeljezara Niksic industrial complex; capacity, IT load and delivery schedule not disclosed. Balkan Green Energy News page later updated 2026-06-02.

name: Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center Tehnopolis Data Center
notes: Tehnopolis official page describes an equipped data center for development teams, startups and IT companies; Vijesti reported in 2022 that the center was newly available for companies' application development and large-data analysis.

name: Telenor Data Center in Pljevlja
notes: IBT reference page lists fire detection and firefighting work at the Telenor Data Center in Pljevlja. No public capacity or commissioning date found.

name: One Montenegro / former Telenor Data Center Podgorica
notes: Vijesti reports the Telenor Data Center was built in Podgorica in 2015, ISO 27001 certified for telehousing in 2016, later expanded to ISO 27001/27701, and covers 780 square meters. IBT separately references maintenance work at Telenor Data Center THQ.

name: Crnogorski Telekom Data Center Podgorica / Telekom CG TGD01
notes: Crnogorski Telekom official colocation page states it offers server colocation in its Podgorica Data Center and a Bijelo Polje data recovery site. Vijesti reported the new modern data center opening in 2020. Inflect lists TGD01 in Podgorica and reports 150 kW power capacity; capacity should be treated as third-party directory data.

name: Montenegro state Tier III data center by 4iG
developer: 4iG International Digital Infrastructure for Government of Montenegro
notes: 4iG official announcement says Montenegro selected 4iG Group for law-enforcement technology and establishing a data centre with related infrastructure. DCD reports the facility is planned as a Tier III-certified state data center, but location, size and capacity were not disclosed. Assigned to Podgorica because it is a central-government/state data-center project; exact site remains unconfirmed.
